propositions: transition_issue_by_name resolves target names against transition name only, not destination status name, causing lookups to fail when transition and status names differ

callers pass destination status names (e.g. 'In Progress') via LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA, but the transport compares against transition names (e.g. 'Start Progress'), triggering ValueError that soft-fails silently with no status change applied
some statuses update successfully (when transition name equals status name) while others fail silently, creating the appearance of a flaky or partial bridge rather than a systematic mapping defect
the mechanism catches ValueError in apply_handlers, appends to bridge_alerts, logs WARNING, and exits the pass with code 0, hiding the failure from observers
Cloud workflows accidentally hide the bug by naming transitions after their destination statuses, whereas Data Center classic workflow separates the two spellings
